title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
Role: Senior AI Platform Engineer
Core Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, LangGraph, Docker, Kubernetes
Experience Required: 5+ years

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain core multi-agent recruitment backend pipelines and service platforms.
- Optimize pgvector similarity search metrics and semantic search queries.
- Orchestrate agent workflows using LangGraph and integrate LLM models (Gemini/OpenAI).

Prerequisites:
- Strong experience in software architectures and microservices.
- Hands-on vector database experience and prompt engineering.

title: NLP Research Scientist
description:
Role: NLP Research Scientist
Core Stack: PyTorch, HuggingFace, Transformers, Python, SentencePiece, AWS
Experience Required: 3+ years

Responsibilities:
- Train and fine-tune large language models and representation embeddings.
- Research tokenizer adaptations and prefix-tuning modifications.
- Deploy NLP model gateways on cloud environments.

Prerequisites:
- M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Linguistics, or related mathematics field.
- Strong track record of deep learning research publications.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Role: Computer Vision Engineer
Core Stack: C++, Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow, CUDA, YOLOv8, PyTorch
Experience Required: 4+ years

Responsibilities:
- Build edge detection, object segmentation, and tracking algorithms for real-time cameras.
- Optimize inference speeds using CUDA bindings and TensorRT compilation.
- Manage visual datasets pipelines.

Prerequisites:
- 4+ years developing low-latency vision algorithms.
- Experience in C++ optimizations and deep learning models.

title: MLOps Architect
description:
Role: MLOps Architect
Core Stack: Python, MLflow, Kubernetes, KubeFlow, Triton Server, AWS, Terraform
Experience Required: 5+ years

Responsibilities:
- Design candidate feature stores and automate model CI/CD pipelines.
- Oversee model serving layers using Triton Inference Server on Kubernetes cluster hubs.
- Standardize monitoring systems for model drift and input feature anomaly detection.

Prerequisites:
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes deployments.
- Strong Python skills and familiarity with machine learning workflows.

title: LLM Application Developer
description:
Role: LLM Application Developer
Core Stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, LangChain, Pinecone, LlamaIndex
Experience Required: 2+ years

Responsibilities:
- Build responsive web wrappers and AI agent copilot UI layouts.
- Connect Pinecone similarity vectors index contexts to prompt payloads.
- Design chain-of-thought system prompts for conversational assistants.

Prerequisites:
- 2+ years building JavaScript/TypeScript frontend systems.
- Familiarity with LangChain/LlamaIndex and prompt patterns.

title: Junior Data Scientist
description:
Role: Junior Data Scientist
Core Stack: Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, SQL, Jupyter, Tableau
Experience Required: 1+ years

Responsibilities:
- Clean candidate features datasets, handle null parameters, and extract statistical metrics.
- Formulate basic regression and clustering classifiers to identify candidate categories.
- Construct dashboard reports outlining candidate behavior profiles.

Prerequisites:
- Degree in Data Science, Statistics, or Math.
- Solid Python Pandas and SQL query skills.

title: Embedded AI Engineer (TinyML)
description:
Role: Embedded AI Engineer
Core Stack: C, C++, ARM Cortex, TensorFlow Lite, Keil, STM32
Experience Required: 4+ years

Responsibilities:
- Port compressed neural network weights to low-power microcontrollers.
- Implement post-training 8-bit integer quantization.
- Conduct hardware-in-the-loop latency tests on ARM microcontrollers.

Prerequisites:
- 4+ years in firmware development or low-level C programming.
- Knowledge of TFLite Micro or model compression techniques.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
Role: AI Product Manager
Core Focus: Agile, Roadmap planning, LLM evaluations, Recruiter UX, Analytics
Experience Required: 4+ years

Responsibilities:
- Lead system design definitions for automated AI resume sourcing tools.
- Benchmark accuracy metrics across GPT and Gemini model outputs.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to define data schema variables and analytics tabs.

Prerequisites:
- 4+ years in product management.
- Basic understanding of AI models, APIs, and recruiter user journeys.

title: Deep Learning Solutions Architect
description:
Role: Deep Learning Solutions Architect
Core Stack: PyTorch, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Docker, Python, ONNX
Experience Required: 6+ years

Responsibilities:
- Advise enterprise clients on transitioning legacy backend servers to deep learning cloud pipelines.
- Create standard deployment templates for SageMaker training jobs.
- Set up low-latency model inference pipelines with ONNX bindings.

Prerequisites:
- 6+ years building enterprise architectures.
- Strong technical skills in PyTorch, Docker, and Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).

title: Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
Role: Reinforcement Learning Engineer
Core Stack: Python, PyTorch, Ray/RLlib, OpenAI Gym, Mujoco, C++
Experience Required: 3+ years

Responsibilities:
- Design reward shaping algorithms and policy training graphs for control tasks.
- Scale parallel environments training pipelines using Ray cluster hubs.
- Integrate physics constraints into simulator environments.

Prerequisites:
- Deep knowledge of RL algorithms (PPO, SAC, DDPG).
- Strong math foundations in Markov Decision Processes and calculus.
